fields.value: Replication Data for: More infinitive, less subjunctive: a diachronic perspective on the integration of Spanish aconsejar and recomendar into the causative category

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This dataset contains the original concordance reports used in “More Infinitive, Less Subjunctive: A Diachronic Perspective on Spanish aconsejar and recomendar” (2026) by Loporcaro Fabio.

Navigate with the repository’s tree-view panel to explore the three-level structure:
VERB (Aconsejar, Recomendar) → CORPUS (CDH, CREA, CORPES) → PATTERN (Pattern 1, Pattern 2, Pattern 3). Inside each Pattern folder the Word (.doc) concordance files are named for the time span they cover (e.g. 1901-1937.doc).

Every document is a plain-text concordance list; each token-level observation is tagged with year and clause pattern.

For full details on data collection and coding, see the methodological section of the article.
